scientific_integrity: Complete finite-dimensional spectral proof supplied; exact checker supplements but does not replace it. Novelty comparison has residual risk of stronger unlocated general resolvent theorems; self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Connected undirected finite symmetric fixed-edge Laplacians, common edge-strength multiplier, fixed intrinsic s in [0,1], equilibrium not temporal evolution. Path constructions prescribe real intrinsic opinions; they are not binary-only. Reversal count concerns a fixed pair, while global variance is centered Euclidean squared deviation. No independent audit or empirical validation.
title: Sharp pairwise opinion-order reversals under increasing social influence
